page.overview:
Who is Cosmo Genovese?

Cosmo Genovese was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2353, he was listed as a Starfleet Operational Support Services officer on a directory placard for Starbase 32, Maxia sector. His office was located in room #35951. (, directory)

In 2365, he was listed as the commander of the on the Starship Deploy Status chart in the Starbase 173 courtroom. (, okudagram)

In the 2370s, he was listed as a Fleet Ops officer on the dedication plaques of the , in 2371, and the , in 2373. (, ; , )
